title: The Last Garden Again
author: P. M. Hartwell
blurb: Quentin Ravensworth, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
